maintenance_led.reason: Aviation Products segment sells aftermarket CFM56/V2500 engine parts, modules and maintenance/exchange services for existing engines; leasing is the smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are commercial airlines and lessors paying for engine parts, exchanges and leases; not government-funded.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from its own engine maintenance, parts (Module Factory, PMA/USM) and leasing business, not regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Airlines depend on certified engines, modules and parts for flight operations; switching needs airworthiness qualification and risks aircraft downtime.

notes: Company also has an aerospace leasing segment; the aviation products and maintenance business is judged the larger part.
